create_random_erasing_augmentation: create a RandomErasing transform to randomly erase rectangular regions in image tensors
apply_random_erasing_to_batch: apply the RandomErasing transform to a batch of normalized image tensors
configure_erasing_pixel_mode: configure RandomErasing with pixel mode for per-pixel random normal color erasing
use_get_pixels_helper: use the _get_pixels helper to generate random or zero-filled pixel patches
test_random_erasing_on_single_image: test the RandomErasing transform on a single 3D image tensor
